capabilities: Browse all media files in a gallery
Search media by folders, tags, or file types
Create sidecar files for each media file
Add notes and tags to media via sidecar files
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault first because the plugin creates and edits a file for each media file, and notes only default-supported file types are officially supported; audio and 3D file formats are planned but not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian attachments are hard to browse and cannot carry their own notes or tags, making media files difficult to search and annotate.
summary: Creates a searchable gallery of vault media files and sidecar files where you can add notes and tags to each attachment.
